ue / red emergency roof mounted bar LED lights, blue LED grille lights and blue LED strobe lights, siren amplifiers and public address system combination. BACKGROUND Background The municipality/traffic department has procured new traffic vehicles to strengthen law enforcement, emergency response, and road safety operations across our jurisdiction. For these vehicles to be legally compliant and operationally effective, they must be fitted with approved emergency warning equipment. 2. Purpose The purpose of supplying and installing sirens and blue lights on the new traffic vehicles is to: - Ensure Legal Compliance: Meet the requirements of the National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996 and relevant regulations which mandate that traffic law enforcement vehicles must be clearly identifiable and equipped with audible and visual warning devices when responding to emergencies. - Enhance Emergency Response: Enable traffic officers to respond rapidly and safely to accidents, crime scenes, road blockages, and other incidents that threaten public safety. - Improve Visibility and Authority: Make traffic vehicles easily recognizable to the public, especially at night, during adverse weather, and in high-traffic areas, thereby deterring traffic violations and improving compliance.

TERMS OF REFERENCE PURPOSE The purpose of this memorandum is to request the procurement of chain saws and brush cutters for the Parks and Recreation Section to improve the maintenance and management of municipal parks, open spaces, sidewalks, and public recreational facilities. BACKGROUND The Parks and Recreation Section is responsible for the maintenance of public parks, trimming, clearing of bushy areas, and ensuring that municipal open spaces remain clean, safe, and accessible to the community. Currently, the section is experiencing challenges due to the shortage and ageing condition of existing equipment.
